about: The lab's know-how, one rule per entry, each with the evidence that proves it: test or probe (re-run here; probes on the real BDS, again after each Minecraft update), measured (seen here once), source (a reference project says so; shown [source] until a test or probe proves it here). `match` (a regex) puts the rule under the E/W/Q/✘ line it explains, the moment it happens; `misses` counts how often its failure still happened in units (recounted by skill learn). `log` is one line per generation (skill growth). `node lab.mjs skill build` writes the rule lines of every skills/<skill>/SKILL.md from here; `skill learn [--from <repo>]` adds candidates from what failed and got fixed and from other skill projects; `skill bench` keeps a change only if it does not make builds worse. status: verified | candidate (not in SKILL.md) | disputed (its evidence failed) | retired. `entry` (a phrase of AGENTS.md): AGENTS.md already says this rule, which every AI in the lab has loaded, so the lab prints the skill without it (SKILL.md keeps it for installs elsewhere; if the phrase leaves AGENTS.md the rule shows again). `tags`: words (any language) a request uses for this rule; a catalog skill printed by skill route shows the lines whose words fit the request (never printed).

rules.rule: No world.* at the top level of a script (it throws while the world loads): do it in kit ready(() => ...) or world.afterEvents.worldLoad.
rules.why: TypeError / early execution at load; the addon does nothing
rules.entry: world.* at the top level throws (use events/ready)

rules.rule: A before-event is read-only: teleport, give, addScore/setScore, addTag and set blocks in system.run(() => ...) inside it (setDynamicProperty and sendMessage work directly).
rules.why: "Native function ... cannot be used in restricted execution"

rules.rule: objective.getScore(p) throws "Failed to resolve identity" until p has a score in some objective; hasParticipant is false then. Use addScore(p, n) (it creates the score) or hasParticipant(p) ? getScore(p) : 0.
rules.why: works in a test that sets a score first, crashes for a new player

rules.rule: runCommandAsync is gone in @minecraft/server 2.x: use runCommand (or the API itself: teleport, addItem).
rules.why: TypeError: not a function after a game update

rules.rule: world.beforeEvents.chatSend exists only in beta modules (node lab.mjs mode beta); on stable, make the chat word a custom command (kit cmd).
rules.why: cannot read property 'subscribe' of undefined at load

rules.rule: A module version x.y.z-beta exists only in the BDS it was made for; stable versions carry over to newer BDS.
rules.why: "@minecraft/server 1.9.0-beta is not in this BDS" after an update

rules.rule: What scripts keep in variables (Map, object) is lost on /reload and restart; what must survive goes into dynamic properties (kit save/load).
rules.why: "my homes disappear after a restart"

rules.rule: A closed form gives canceled (selection / formValues undefined): check it before reading the answer; kit ask/menu/input/confirm return undefined then.
rules.why: cannot read property 'selection' of undefined when a player presses Esc

rules.rule: A form shown while the player has another screen open is refused (UserBusy): kit ask() retries; plain show() does not.
rules.why: the form never appears when opened from a chat word or right after joining

rules.rule: Count a catch by playerInventoryItemChange (a fish arrives) right after the player used the rod (itemUse); there is no fishing event.
rules.why: api ?fish finds nothing

evidence.ref: events on itemUse, playerInventoryItemChange while fishing (BDS 1.26.52.3)

rules.rule: tests.txt sections run in order in ONE world: items, cooldowns, saved data and joined players carry over (`@A join` again prints `@A already joined`). Give each section what it needs, or wait out a cooldown.
rules.why: a section passes alone and fails after the one before it
rules.entry: sections run in order in one world (what one leaves, the next sees)

rules.rule: All real players spawn on the same block (0 -60 0): move one (tp B 4 -60 0) before they throw, fish or shoot, or they hit each other.
rules.why: "the bobber caught on B", projectiles hit the other player

rules.rule: `~` is a regex: escape * . ( ) [ ] + ? (inventory lines are slot:id*n, so ~ minecraft:bread\*2); use = for a whole exact line; ^ ties to the line start (a player's line starts with @A ).
rules.why: want and got look the same and the check still fails

rules.rule: Loot and fishing are random: never expect an exact count; check a range (~ ^[12]$) or a relation (the score equals the fish in the inventory).
rules.why: a test that passes sometimes

evidence.ref: fishing: leather and cod in 2 casts (BDS 1.26.52.3)

rules.rule: Daily or weekly logic: `clock +1d` moves the addon's Date ahead (kept over restart); never add a test-only back door to the addon.
rules.why: no way to test "the next day"

rules.rule: Wait with `until <regex> [ms]` (a 10 s timer: until ... 15000), not a guessed wait; make long durations an argument or a setting so the test can shorten them.
rules.why: flaky timing, or a test that takes minutes

rules.rule: `@A walk forward N`: N is ticks, not blocks (20 ticks = 4.3 blocks; forward = +z, left = +x as spawned); `@A goto x z` for a place.
rules.why: the player stops short of the zone

rules.rule: In a js line: p('A') is the player, inv(p) gives ["slot:id*n"], dim is the overworld itself (dim.getEntities, not dim()), mob(type,x,y,z) spawns.
rules.why: dim.getEntities is not a function

rules.rule: Fishing in a test: a pool ahead of the player (fill -8 -64 2 8 -61 24 water), enchant A lure 3 (about 8 s a catch), @A fish_n n 30.
rules.why: "the bobber landed on grass"

rules.rule: world.sendMessage / say prints as one plain line on BDS; a player's chat shows on every player, the sender too, as `@B chat <A> text`; in Endstone a broadcast shows as each player's line (@A ...).
rules.why: ~ ^text misses because the line is "@A text"

rules.rule: Look up vanilla files before writing JSON: `sample recipe`, `sample recipes/glass_bottle.json`, `doc minecraft:recipe_shapeless`.
rules.why: a guessed format the game rejects

rules.rule: A shaped/shapeless recipe with format_version 1.20 or later needs "unlock" (e.g. [{"item": "lab:gel"}]), or it does not load.
rules.why: the recipe never appears

rules.rule: A custom item/block component needs both `ns:x={}` in the item/block components (add ... 'ns:x={}') and kit onItem/onBlock('ns:x', ...).
rules.why: the hook never runs (why says so)

rules.rule: A mob's drops: add entity ... drops=ns:item*1-2 writes its loot table; test the kill with a weapon (give a diamond_sword; a fist does 1).
rules.why: the mob does not die in the test

rules.rule: A person's addon: import <file> "<their words>" → read the brief (not every file) → the suggested mode → fix every use the audit lists → go with the draft tests → add a section per thing they asked.
rules.why: one crash per go round, files read one by one
rules.entry: prints its brief (ways in with file:line, what breaks on this BDS's APIs, which `mode`)

rules.rule: Change what they asked and what is broken, nothing else: keep their language (plain JS stays JS), names, pack UUIDs and style; say what you changed unasked.
rules.why: a rewrite the person cannot review

evidence.ref: practice of the reference skills (fix what was pointed at)

rules.rule: Read the first ✘ / E line of go and its fix/hint line before editing; with no file:line go runs why itself; `why "<title>"` shows the values where it threw.
rules.why: edits that do not touch the cause (go says SAME failures)
rules.entry: A failure with no src/ line: go runs `why` itself

rules.rule: sim (about 1 s, no server) is a hint between edits; go on the real server decides. ? UNSURE = the sandbox has not measured that part (movement, a skipped section before).
rules.why: trusting a sim pass

rules.rule: After DONE: gaps (code no test runs) → mutate (bugs no test notices: write the check each one needs) → chaos; a new test must fail on the broken code.
rules.why: tests that pass whatever the code does
rules.entry: `mutate` (small bugs no test notices: the lines that need a check)

rules.rule: Report what ran on the real server (go DONE, the numbers) apart from what only sim or reading showed; name what you decided without asking.
rules.why: claims nobody ran

evidence.ref: practice of the reference skills (say what was not run)

rules.rule: Make waits and limits plugin attributes so a test sets them: `py plugin.idle_seconds = 3` instead of waiting 5 minutes.
rules.why: a test that takes minutes

rules.rule: PyPI packages: lib add <pkg> (writes pyproject); go installs what pyproject declares and is missing.
rules.why: plugin fails to load: No module named ...

rules.rule: The Endstone API is server-thread only: no sleep or blocking I/O there; a thread computes, then self.server.scheduler.run_task(self, fn) brings the result back.
rules.why: every player freezes

rules.rule: Never decide a side or a look from the JSON: the game mirrors models in x (a cube's east UV shows on its low-x side). `render <id> --anim <clip>@0/@end` draws it as the game does; read the PNG before saying it looks right.
rules.why: text on the wrong side, a look reported but never seen

rules.rule: A rotation [rx,ry,rz] is applied as right-handed (-rx, ry, -rz), X then Y then Z, about the pivot; animation rotations ADD to the bind pose.
rules.why: a part tilted the wrong way

rules.rule: No two faces on one plane: move one part 0.02-0.05, then paint the thin step so it continues its neighbour (`check` names each z-fight pair).
rules.why: flicker, then a crack where the step is

rules.rule: texture_width/height must be the PNG's size and every UV inside it; a box UV [u,v] takes 2*(d+w) x (d+h) texels from there.
rules.why: a face drawn with garbage

rules.rule: A wing, fin, leaf or cloth is ONE zero-thickness plate cut out by transparent texels (material entity_alphatest), both faces the same size and painted by position; not a board or a fan of boxes.
rules.why: wings that look like boards; one face paints over the cut-out

rules.rule: A person's Blockbench save wins: lint it (`check`: collapsed / duplicate cubes, UV off), fix only the defects named and say which; never redesign a part nobody pointed at.
rules.why: a rewrite the person rejects

rules.rule: When vanilla has the thing (a wing, a held item, a mount), look first: `render minecraft:<mob>`, `sample rp/models/entity/<name>`.
rules.why: a guessed construction rejected 3 times

rules.rule: A new rp/ui file is loaded only when listed in rp/ui/_ui_defs.json ("ui_defs": ["ui/x.json"]); a file named like a vanilla screen (server_form.json, hud_screen.json) changes that screen and keeps its namespace.
rules.why: nothing changes in the game, no error anywhere

rules.rule: Every name@base is namespace.element that exists in this pack or vanilla (`check` suggests the nearest); look the element up with `sample rp/ui/<screen>.json` instead of guessing.
rules.why: Type not specified (or @-base not found) in the client log

rules.rule: Only texture paths that exist (rp/textures or vanilla); an invented textures/ui/... draws nothing.
rules.why: an invisible image
rules.match: is in neither this pack nor vanilla

rules.rule: Change a vanilla screen with small `modifications` (insert_front / insert_back / replace on its controls), never a copy of the whole file: a copy breaks on the next game update and hides other packs.
rules.why: the screen breaks after a Minecraft update

rules.rule: Custom server forms: put a marker in the form title (title('§s§h§o§p§rShop')) and show the custom control with a view binding on #title_text; tests see the raw title (`~ title\("§s§h§o§p`).
rules.why: every form turns custom, or none does

rules.rule: BDS never loads RP UI and the test clients do not draw it: `check` passing is the only automatic proof. Say what was checked statically and that the look still needs a real client (`app run`, or the person).
rules.why: a look reported that nobody saw

rules.rule: A view binding needs source_property_name and target_property_name; a collection binding needs binding_collection_name.
rules.why: a control that never shows or never updates

rules.rule: A line is what the client shows: § colours gone, trailing spaces trimmed, a rawtext {translate:'k', with:[..]} as `@A %k [a, b]`: match that form (texts: node lab.mjs i18n).
rules.why: a whole go spent on a text that never comes
rules.entry: Lines are as a client shows them: § colours gone, trailing spaces trimmed, a {translate} message as `%key [a, b]`

rules.rule: `!` and `!~` check the whole section, later lines too: to prove something did not happen before a later step makes it, give that check its own section.
rules.why: an absence check fails on what a later line prints

rules.rule: A js line gives its last expression: `js const l = inv(p('A')); l.length` (or `return x`); nothing printed means undefined.
rules.why: want = 2, got only other lines

rules.rule: Daily login / streak: day number from the local date, last day + streak saved per player on initialSpawn; test days with `clock +1d` → bds/addons/daily
rules.why: a test that cannot reach tomorrow
rules.tags: 毎日 ログインボーナス 連続 日替わり daily login streak

rules.rule: A command once a day per player (cooldown over restarts) → bds/addons/coins
rules.why: a cooldown lost on restart
rules.tags: 1日1回 コイン 報酬 once a day

rules.rule: Homes / warps: save<{dim,x,y,z}> per player, teleport with { dimension }, cooldown() → bds/addons/home
rules.why: homes lost on restart or in the wrong dimension
rules.tags: ホーム ワープ テレポート 戻る

rules.rule: Money and a shop: score() on the sidebar, balance via hasParticipant, menu() of goods, /pay refusing self, ≤0 and too much → bds/addons/shop
rules.why: getScore crash for a new player; negative pay
rules.tags: ショップ お金 コイン 買う 売る 送金 経済 money shop pay

rules.rule: A custom item with an effect, a cooldown and a use count on the sidebar; given once on first join → bds/addons/wand
rules.why: spam use; the gift given at every join
rules.tags: アイテム 杖 クールダウン 効果 初参加 配る

rules.rule: Entering / leaving an area: every(5) checks positions, a Set remembers who is inside → bds/addons/zone
rules.why: a message every tick while inside
rules.tags: エリア 範囲 入る 出る 区域

rules.rule: A timed contest: end tick + runTimeout(finish), sidebar scores, prize to the top player still online, seconds as an argument for tests → bds/addons/fishcup
rules.why: a 3-minute test; the prize to someone who left
rules.tags: 大会 釣り 制限時間 賞品 1位 タイマー

rules.rule: A block players toggle (block state) and a name typed in a form, kept over restart → bds/addons/lamp
rules.why: state lost on restart
rules.tags: ブロック ランプ 切り替え 状態

rules.rule: A custom mob with drops, a crafting recipe and a potion effect → bds/addons/jelly
rules.why: the recipe never appears; drops not tested with a weapon
rules.tags: モブ ドロップ レシピ ポーション クラフト

rules.rule: A form with its own look (JSON UI server_form by title marker) → bds/addons/jsonui_demo
rules.why: every form changes look
rules.tags: 見た目 フォーム JSON UI デザイン

rules.rule: A person's addon that broke after an update, fixed in place (their UUIDs, plain JS kept) → bds/addons/teleport_menu (TASK.md lists every change)
rules.why: a rewrite instead of a fix
rules.tags: 修正 壊れた アップデート 人のアドオン

rules.rule: On beta modules: tell them to turn on the world's Beta APIs experiment and that it works only on this Minecraft version; prefer stable when the request allows (go tries it).
rules.why: the addon does nothing in their world

rules.rule: Say which request lines a real-server test proves, and list guesses and unasked changes apart; never claim a look or a feel nobody saw.
rules.why: a report the person cannot trust

rules.rule: A fixed addon keeps its pack UUIDs and goes one version up (go does it after import): their worlds take it as an update.
rules.why: two copies of the addon in their world, or the old one kept

rules.rule: Commands: mc.newCommand(name, desc, PermType.Any) → mandatory/optional → overload([...]) → setCallback((_c, origin, out, r) => ...) → setup(); origin.player is null from the console (out.error); tests see `@A cmd: <success text>`.
rules.why: a command that never registers, or crashes from the console

rules.rule: Offline servers (the lab's, many private ones) give pl.xuid = "": key saved data by pl.xuid || pl.uuid.
rules.why: every player shares one account

rules.rule: Data lives under ./plugins/<n>/ (File.mkdir first; JsonConfigFile, DBSession sqlite3) and survives restart: prove it with a `restart` section.
rules.why: data lost, or written beside the server

rules.rule: Before-style events (onChat, onPlayerCmd, onDestroyBlock ...) are cancelled by returning false from the listener.
rules.why: the vanilla action still happens

rules.rule: `~` regexes are JavaScript and match one line: no (?s) or other inline flags (only a leading (?i)); for an order across lines, compute it in a js/py/lse line and check its value.
rules.why: Invalid regular expression after the server started

rules.rule: A py line's value prints short, not as Python repr: a str as itself, True/False, None as -, lists and tuples as ["B","A",0], dicts as {k=v}: write `=` in that form, or return an f-string.
rules.why: want [('B', 'A', 0)] never matches

rules.rule: Start from the closest working plugin: `node lab.mjs help ideas` lists end/plugins (SQLite and restarts: sqlstats; a report system with cooldowns and an op list: report).
rules.why: a structure guessed from scratch

rules.rule: The lab's players are operators: `deop B` before a section that proves a normal player is refused ("op" permissions).
rules.why: a permission check that is never tested

rules.rule: `restart` keeps plugins/<n>/ and the world and the players rejoin: a section after it proves what must survive; `lse` lines see the mod's top-level names (lab builds).
rules.why: data lost on restart, untested

rules.rule: Start from the closest working mod in ll/mods (`help ideas`): JSON file + op commands + cooldown → warps; SQLite → sqlstats; economy → money.
rules.why: a structure guessed from scratch
